There are 19 beautiful Districts, or "Villages", in Guam.

Each Village has its wonderful, unique attributes.

Take the time to enjoy each Village...and feel free stop by each Mayor's Office to say "Hafa Adai!".

 

A Message from MCOG's Executive Director, Angel R. Sablan

Buenas Yan Hafa Adai!

Welcome to the Mayors' Council of Guam Website. Through this Website you will be provided information on our central office budgets and expenditures, and our village programs and their budgets and expenditures. You will also find useful information about the various village activities and schedule of events. Each village is featured and information on the individual villages is provided by them. The website is designed to give you easy access to each of the nineteen Mayor's offices as well as provide useful links to other departments and agencies.

If you should have any questions or comments, please do not hesitate to contact our office.
